title: Amapiano to boom bap staircase
hook: Amapiano to 90s rap without emptying the floor.
voiceover: Amapiano to 90s rap without emptying the floor. Here's the problem. Amapiano sits around 112 BPM. A 90s boom bap record sits around 90. Jump straight across and the room feels the brakes. What I actually do is a 3 record staircase. Out of the amapiano record I go into an afrobeats record around 105, same swing, same log drum feel. From there into a dancehall or reggaeton record around 98. Now the room is already moving at hip-hop pace, so I drop the 90s record at 92 and nobody notices the gear change. 3 records, about 6 minutes, 20 BPM covered. What's your bridge out of amapiano? Drop the BPM.
caption: The transition I get asked about most. Amapiano (around 112) into 90s rap (around 90) is a 20 BPM drop, and if you take it in one jump the floor feels it. My fix is a 3 record staircase: afrobeats at 105, dancehall or reggaeton at 98, then the boom bap record. DJs: what's your bridge out of amapiano? Drop the BPM you land on.
